Latin word

gubernō

gubernō, gubernāre, gubernāvī, gubernātum

verb, first conjugation

steer; direct, manage; drive; steer, pilot; steer; govern a state

    also used · classical · Cic. Fam. 2.7.1: ut omnia gubernēs

    also used · classical · Cic. Rosc. Am. 131: orbemque terrārum gubernāret (Lewis & Short); Traupman 179, 323: rem pūblicam gubernāre; Traupman 323
